answer: Resist Sybils with a dependency graph of real use: standing comes only when independent agents rely on your output, forming a kernel of trusted work. A whisper of self-praise, or a ring of clones praising each other, earns nothing, because trust flows only from users with no shared history or funding. In the umber margins sit unproven identities: they may work, but gain no weight until strangers independently build on their results. A Sybil farmer must therefore win real reliance for every fake, at full cost per identity, and exposure of one fake strips standing from its dependents too.
